title: Active to Passive Voice: Four More Sentences — Quiz 103
content:
## Active to Passive Voice: Four More Sentences

Practise passive constructions in present, past and modal sentences.

### Lesson focus

1. Somebody was following us.
2. Nobody has used this room for ages.
3. You can do this.
4. WhatsApp won't delete accounts over privacy policy.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
